services.title: Slack query
services.summary: Diff App Manifest apps vs config; optional --import from apps.manifest.export (JSON on stdout).

services.title: Slack deploy
services.summary: Create managed Slack apps via App Manifest API; store signing secret / client credentials in vault.

services.title: Slack maintain
services.summary: Update managed app manifests (interactivity URL, scopes); rotate config tokens; print portal checklist.

next_steps: Run `hdc run infrastructure slack query --` to verify manifest drift.
Install the app to the workspace, then `hdc secrets set HDC_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`.
Set interactivity request URL to https://<hdc-web>/api/slack/interactions (managed via maintain).
Enable notifications.channels.slack-hdc-app and add slack-hdc-app to routes.needs_decision.
